name: Henry Metcalfe
role: Keeps the coin shop that sells no coins; Monday visits
temper_why: the coin shop that sells no coins; never the police (2.5.2)

card.who: He keeps Metcalfe's, a coin shop on Quay Street that sells no coins. Things are left at his back door in the alley at night.
card.speak: Sparse, sour, precise. Answers questions with questions.
card.life: Lives over the shop. Takes a pot of tea at the Copper Kettle at half twelve. Has one tray in the window and it has never changed.
card.fire: He has no opinion and says so twice.
card.rivals: He takes what Garbutt sends and asks nothing.
card.secret: He receives the bag from the ferry and passes it on. He does not know what is in it and does not want to.
